title: BaRISTA: Brain Scale Informed Spatiotemporal Representation of Human Intracranial Neural Activity
goal: Reproduce the original spatial-encoding comparison with channel masking held fixed: pretrained channel/channel, parcel/channel and lobe/channel models and their three matching random-initialized encoding controls on both sentence-onset and speech/non-speech decoding, including chronological sensitivity. Preserve all seven original test sessions, five fine-tuning seeds, original random nonoverlapping partitions and all five chronological folds. Assess candidate improvement on these same named endpoints and observation support against a fixed qualified competent author comparator, with exposure and search budgets disclosed.

Source-paper comparison for Main random-nonoverlap sentence-onset ROC-AUC (numeric anchor only; complete original endpoint panel required): Classification ROC-AUC is the probability a positive score ranks above a negative, with half credit for ties, computed over all queries in a session/seed/fold. Native code uses roc_auc_score. Reconstruction reports MSE and R², but historical evaluation denominator/flattening and full reconstruction producer are not recovered; training token loss and locally declared MSE are different quantities.
